d:
When unexpected visitors create chaos, Ernie Brown Jr. teams up with Neal James to handle a string of unpredictable wildlife rescue calls. Each encounter brings a different creature and a new challenge for the crew.
From tricky snake rescue missions to stubborn raccoons and turtles that keep the team busy, these animal rescue adventures rarely go according to plan. With wild critters on the loose and surprises around every corner, can Turtleman and his team bring the chaos under control?
Watch Call of the Wildman, Season 3, Episodes 18, 2, 10, 6, 19, 13 and 8, on Animal Planet India.
